checks.note: ERP, payments and Slack tokens are fetched at run time via STS token exchange of the projected workload token. The Anthropic client is built with no explicit credential, so it reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the environment. Neither deployment.yaml nor any other repo file supplies it, so its source and whether it is a static key cannot be determined. The Slack signing secret and mail HMAC key are mounted static secrets, but they only verify inbound requests.
